tour.e0.b: Post opportunities and meet students whose skills are endorsed by their teachers.
tour.e1.b: See who applied, who was recommended by a teacher, and the students Thiran suggests for each listing.
tour.e2.b: Filter by district, skill and career goal. Unlock a Talent Passport to see endorsements and badges.
tour.e3.b: Apprenticeships, internships, jobs or CSR scholarships. Matching students are found right away.
tour.e4.b: Students reached, applications and placements, ready for CSR reporting.
tour.e5.b: You see first names only, and contact goes through the student’s teacher. Tap ? to see this tour again.
tour.l0.b: Thiran helps students find what they are good at, plan how to grow it, and reach scholarships, apprenticeships and jobs. Let me show you around. It takes 30 seconds.
tour.l1.b: Thiran works in English, Tamil and Hindi. Switch here on any screen, and the text and voice change with it.
tour.l2.b: Large buttons make it easy to pick a language, even for first-time phone users.
tour.l3.b: No email needed. Students, teachers and employers all log in here. New here? Tap "Create an account".
tour.l4.b: Explore Thiran as a student, a teacher or an employer with one tap. The PIN is 1234.
tour.l5.b: Tap ? on any main screen to see this guide again.
tour.s0.b: Here is how Thiran takes you from "what am I good at?" to a real scholarship or job, one step at a time.
tour.s1.b: Talk or tap to answer a few easy questions. Thiran learns your interests, strengths and goals.
tour.s2.b: See careers from many fields, from skilled trades to healthcare, each with a reason it fits you, the pay and the training time.
tour.s3.b: A plan built from free courses and real exams. Tick each step as you finish it to earn badges.
tour.s4.b: Scholarships, government schemes and apprenticeships you qualify for, with the reasons and how to apply.
tour.s5.b: Your badges and teacher endorsements in one place. Share it with a QR code.
tour.s6.b: Short lessons made by teachers, in your language.
tour.s7.b: Change the language here anytime. No internet? Keep going; your progress syncs when you are back online.
tour.s7.t: Works on any phone, even offline
tour.t0.b: Guide your whole class from one phone: spot talent, endorse skills and connect students to opportunities.
tour.t1.b: How many students have finished their profile, chosen a career goal and applied for something.
tour.t2.b: AI suggestions from your class data, for example a student who is eligible for scholarships but has not applied.
tour.t3.b: Tap a student to endorse a skill, recommend them for an opportunity, or use Thiran for them on your phone.
tour.t4.b: One phone can serve many students. Add them here and switch between them with a tap.
tour.t5.b: Publish your own lessons for free, per module or as a subscription.
tour.t6.b: Employers cannot contact students directly. Their requests come to you to accept or decline.
